integrations.title: Engineering integrations
integrations.description: Sync product requests both ways with Jira, Linear or GitHub.
integrations.forbidden: Viewing engineering integrations needs permission to view settings.
integrations.read_only: You can see the status of each integration. Setting up, connecting or disabling one needs permission to edit settings.
integrations.state_hint.disabled: The settings are kept but syncing is off; nothing is exchanged with {{provider}}.
integrations.state_hint.needs_auth: Settings are saved. Authorize with your {{provider}} account to start syncing.
integrations.disconnect_confirm.title: Disable the {{provider}} integration?
integrations.disconnect_confirm.descript: Syncing stops: no new requests are sent to this provider and its changes are not received. Saved settings and credentials are not deleted, and you can enable it again at any time. To remove access completely, also revoke the app on the provider side.
integrations.dialog.title: {{provider}} settings
integrations.dialog.description: Secrets are not shown again after saving. A secret field left empty keeps the stored value.
integrations.target.title: Where requests go
integrations.hints.jira.cloud_id: The ID (UUID) of your Atlassian site.
integrations.hints.jira.project_id: Key of the project requests are created in, for example SUP.
integrations.hints.jira.issue_type: Task is used when left empty.
integrations.hints.linear.team_id: UUID of the Linear team requests are created in.
integrations.hints.linear.project_id: When set, new requests are added to this project.
integrations.states.title: Status mapping
integrations.states.hint.jira: Enter the Jira status ID for each ClickFix status. Unmapped statuses are not synced.
integrations.states.hint.linear: Enter the Linear state UUID for each ClickFix status. Unmapped statuses are not synced.
integrations.transitions.title: Transition mapping
integrations.transitions.hint.jira: Enter the Jira transition ID that moves an issue into that status.
integrations.oauth.title: OAuth app
integrations.oauth.hint.jira: Create an OAuth 2.0 (3LO) app in the Atlassian developer console and add the redirect URI below.
integrations.oauth.hint.linear: Create an OAuth application in Linear and add the redirect URI below.
integrations.oauth.hint.github: Create an OAuth app on GitHub and enter the address below as its callback URL.
integrations.oauth.not_ready: To connect, first save the OAuth client ID, client secret and an HTTPS redirect URI in the settings.
integrations.hints.redirect_uri: Must be HTTPS and match the provider app exactly.
integrations.webhook.title: Webhook
integrations.webhook.hint.jira: Enter the same secret when you define a signed admin webhook in Jira. At least 16 characters; not shown again after saving.
integrations.webhook.hint.linear: Enter the same secret when you define the Linear webhook. At least 16 characters; not shown again after saving.
integrations.webhook.hint.github: Enter the same secret when you define the repository webhook. At least 16 characters; not shown again after saving.
integrations.webhook.path_hint: Append it to your ClickFix API address as the webhook URL at the provider.
integrations.invalid.site_url: Enter a valid address that starts with HTTPS.
integrations.invalid.redirect_uri: The redirect URI must start with HTTPS.
integrations.invalid.webhook_secret: The webhook secret must be at least 16 characters.
integrations.errors.unknown: The action could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
integrations.errors.invalid: The settings were not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
integrations.errors.forbidden: This action needs permission to edit settings.
integrations.errors.not_configured: This integration is not set up yet. Save its settings first.
integrations.errors.unavailable: The provider could not be reached or the integration is unavailable. Check that the integration is enabled and the OAuth details are correct.
integrations.errors.repository: The repository must be in owner/repo form.
integrations.errors.cloud_id: Cloud ID is required or malformed.
integrations.errors.redirect_uri: The redirect URI must start with HTTPS.
integrations.errors.site_url: The site URL must start with HTTPS.
integrations.errors.webhook_secret: The webhook secret must be at least 16 characters.
integrations.errors.states: The status mapping contains an unknown status.
integrations.errors.oauth_not_ready: To connect, the integration must be enabled, with OAuth client details and an HTTPS redirect URI saved.
integrations.errors.state_expired: The authorization request expired or was already used. Start the connection again from the settings screen.
integrations.errors.state_invalid: The authorization response is invalid. Start the connection again from the settings screen.
integrations.callback.title: {{provider}} connection
integrations.callback.cancelled: You returned without granting access; nothing changed. You can try again at any time.
integrations.callback.provider_error: {{provider}} did not complete the authorization. Start the connection again from the settings screen.
integrations.callback.missing: This page is only used on return from the provider. Start the connection from the settings screen.
